get_package_version: get the version of a Python package like transformers or trl using the Version utility
convert_dtype_string: convert a dtype string like bfloat16 to its corresponding torch dtype using _get_dtype
check_main_process: check if the current process is the main process in a distributed training setup
run_distributed_function: run a function only on the main process and broadcast results to all ranks
get_file_lock: get a file lock for a target path with an optional timeout for safe concurrent access
